import sys, json, copy; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo
# two parallel links between the same nodes with identical delay -> two optimal predecessors
prof={'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[]}
fab={'n':2,'interval_ns':10,'slice_ns':20,'offset_ns':0,'drift_ppb':[0,0],'heat':[],
     'anchors':[[0,0,2]],
     'links':[{'ends':[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],'delay_ns':[5,5],'defer_rounds':[0,0]},
              {'ends':[[0,1,0],[1,1,0]],'delay_ns':[5,5],'defer_rounds':[0,0]}],
     'slices':[[0,1]],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0],'reconfig_ns':0}
plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fab)
print(json.dumps(plan))
P=plan['period_rounds']; N=fab['n']
print('audit own:', algo.audit(prof,fab,plan))
# swap the witness of every hop cell to the alternative link code
alt=copy.deepcopy(plan)
for p in range(P):
    for i in range(N):
        c=alt['pred'][p][i]
        if c and c[1]!=-1:
            alt['pred'][p][i]=[c[0], 1 if c[1]==0 else 0]
print('audit alternative witnesses:', algo.audit(prof,fab,alt))
# verify the alternative is genuinely valid (same labels)
import importlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from certcheck import validate_plan
print('independent validation of the alternative:', validate_plan(prof,fab,alt))
EOF
